## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF, confirmed by breadth of 0/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness) and negative weekly returns in both Financials and Industrials. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5), but the leaders are isolated stock gains amid universal sector weakness.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples is most resilient at -0.18% for the week: KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND and PG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities (-1.19%) and Communication (-1.56%) follow; DUK (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +8.10%) and DIS (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) are ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology leads the downside at -6.94% for the week: NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) and ORCL (1W: -11.29% | 1M: -13.15%) are BELOW TREND. Materials (-5.28%) and Healthcare (-4.42%) also lag; FCX (1W: -17.18% | 1M: -25.29%) and UNH (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) are BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND; TJX (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -4.21%) RECOVERY; AVGO (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND; DIS (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +26.50%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), though overall sector breadth remains weak.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: FCX (1W: -17.18% | 1M: -25.29%), NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%), CRM (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -21.46%), INTC (1W: -12.53% | 1M: -40.38%) and NOW (1W: -11.84% | 1M: -39.42%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves include KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND and TJX (1W: +3.19% | 1M: -4.21%) RECOVERY. Major divergence is present: AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +3.89%), TSLA (1W: -1.82% | 1M: +2.68%) and V (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +2.32%) are all in CORRECTION; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -6.94% for the week and -12.26% for the month. AVGO (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) is ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) and MSFT (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -4.43%) are BELOW TREND; constituent-positive breadth was not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak: sector returns are -3.60% for the week and -0.22% for the month, with 0/11 sectors positive overall. JPM (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -3.33%) is BELOW TREND, while V (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +2.32%) and MA (1W: -2.63% | 1M: +3.70%) are in CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Sector returns are -4.42% for the week and -0.72% for the month. UNH (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) and PFE (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -5.45%) are BELOW TREND; LLY (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +7.85%) and JNJ (1W: -2.75% | 1M: +5.14%) are in CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor relative resilience in KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND and PG (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistent weakness such as NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; zero positive sectors and major trend divergences argue for restraint.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) ABOVE TREND, if gains hold amid weak breadth. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) BELOW TREND, if downside momentum persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples is relatively resilient at -0.18% weekly, but remains negative; watch for sector breadth to turn positive. BEARISH: Technology (-6.94%), Materials (-5.28%) and Healthcare (-4.42%) show the steepest weekly declines; overall breadth is 0/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price-level data was not supplied, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be verified. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -13.11% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND stabilizes and whether AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +3.89%) CORRECTION resolves; broad confirmation requires sector breadth to improve from 0/11.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DIS (+65): earnings beat and savings plan; DIS (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +9.57%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. TGT (+55): raised 2026 outlook; TGT (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.51%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed; LLY (+50): Canadian approval tied to cardiovascular risk reduction; LLY (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +7.85%) CORRECTION, short-term price action diverges.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (-48): downgrade and slumping gold; FCX (1W: -17.18% | 1M: -25.29%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. META (-35): questions around AI spending and cash flow; META (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -11.22%) BELOW TREND, confirmed; UNH (-30): proposed CMS anti-fraud rule pressures insurers; UNH (1W: -13.16% | 1M: -16.54%) BELOW TREND, confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF; style is mixed with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership, as breadth is 0/11 sectors positive. KHC (1W: +4.82% | 1M: +6.76%) and AVGO (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.89%) remain ABOVE TREND despite broad weakness. Major trend divergence and falling Technology stocks warrant monitoring; negative sentiment on META coincides with its BELOW TREND performance.
